name: apprenti.dev Data Analytics and AI Apprenticeship
audience: University student complementing a Mathematics, Statistics, or Computer Science degree
philosophy: Evidence-driven apprenticeship: question, measure, model, disclose, review.
aiPrinciples: AI assistance must be disclosed when materially used.
Models and prompts are evaluated on held-out cases, not vibes.
The apprentice remains accountable for every number and generated sentence.
Mentor approval is based on demonstrated understanding, not leaderboard score.
